description: Submit the signed-in customer's finished application to the firm. Only call it after showing the customer the firm's terms and policies (get_firm_overview links them) and the declaration that the application is true and complete, and after they explicitly agree. Submitting again after a change sends the update.

application_id.description: The application's id (obs_…), from list_applications or start_application.

terms_accepted.description: The customer has read the firm's terms and policies and declares the application true and complete. Only true after they explicitly agree.

name: submit_application
title: Submit an application
